div.head: Quadr Arg 21
div.ab: Si bellorum casus, proditorum dolos, temptationes exteras, domesticorum insidias, si triumphata sepius incommoda, si celebranda uirtutum præconia, si multas persequentium turbinum legiones perpessas accumulem, tedium legentibus uel tanti regis laudibus detrimenta uereor induxisse.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 534 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Zu Z. 4 vereor vgl. Stilähnliches Ded. 3
On l. 4 vereor cf. the stylistically similar Ded. 3

div.ab: If I were to heap up the chances of wars, the wiles of traitors, foreign assaults, the plots of those of the household, if the troubles often overcome, if the proclamations of virtues to be celebrated, if the many legions of persecuting whirlwinds endured, I fear I should bring tedium to readers or detriment to the praises of so great a king.
